name: kilo-qol-patch
description: QoL patch for Kilo Code: drag & drop @file/@folder mentions, full keyboard controls, KaTeX math, raw markdown toggle, custom typography, inline MCP images, cross-workspace chat history.

commands.title: Kilo QoL Patch: Toggle Show All Chats

kiloQolPatch.autoApply.description: Automatically apply the patch on startup and after a Kilo Code update replaces the webview. When off, you will be asked before applying.

kiloQolPatch.showStatusBar.description: Show a status bar indicator for the patch state.

kiloQolPatch.keyboardShortcuts.description: Enable full keyboard enhancements: Enter inserts newline, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends message, smart Escape routes safely, Cmd/Ctrl+Up/Down navigates message history, and typing in textarea cannot trigger permission dialogs.

kiloQolPatch.addAttachFileButton.description: Add a `+` button to the Kilo Code prompt toolbar that opens the file picker directly.

kiloQolPatch.chatMathRendering.description: Render `$...$` inline math and `\[...\]` display math in chat via KaTeX.

kiloQolPatch.chatMathFontSizeEm.description: Font size of rendered math in chat, in `em` relative to surrounding text.

kiloQolPatch.chatRawMarkdownButton.description: Add a button beside Copy under assistant replies to toggle between rendered markdown and raw markdown source.

kiloQolPatch.chatHistoryFontSizeEm.description: Multiply font size of agent rendered responses in chat history relative to Kilo Code Display font size (1 is unchanged).

kiloQolPatch.chatHistoryFontFamily.description: CSS font-family for agent rendered responses in chat history (e.g. 'Charter, Georgia, serif'). Empty keeps default.

kiloQolPatch.fillChatWidth.description: Apply style enhancements (full-width chat, bordered tool cards, readable dark code blocks). When off, original styling is restored.

kiloQolPatch.showAllChats.description: Show all chats in the Kilo Code history sidebar, including sessions from other workspace folders. The patch keeps cross-workspace/cloud sessions visible instead of pruning them to the current folder. Requires a Reload Window after toggling.

kiloQolPatch.renameOpenInTab.description: Retitle Kilo Code's editor-title 'Open in Tab' action to 'Kilo Code: Open' so its icon groups next to other AI Open icons.
